summary: Require all first-party EKODI production HTTP/HTTPS entrypoints on https://ekodi.kr paths; remove legacy legacy EKODI web subdomains web bindings and HTTP DNS after readiness verification, not by permanent redirect.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly approved the proposed whole-ecosystem apex-only migration in the 2026-10-23 conversation and instructed EKODI to modify and update.
pendingProductionChange: No Cloudflare production DNS deletion is approved for execution until per-host mapping, callback updates and production evidence pass C3 release gates; approval here authorizes the migration policy, not unsafe bulk deletion.
rollback: Revert policy/code through approved PR pipeline and restore the last verified route release. Production DNS removals require per-host backups and verified reattachment capability before deletion.
